item.title: New report flags Lyme-positive ticks on Sonoma trail
item.description: Ticks collected along Umbrella Tree Trail at North Sonoma Regional Park tested positive in pooled samples for the Lyme disease bacterium — a higher-than-usual signal, even in a small sample. Lyme can hit like a truck, and it’s far easier to prevent than to untangle later.

item.title: UN approves 40-member scientific panel on the impact of artificial intelligence over US objections
item.description: The U.N. General Assembly voted Thursday to approve a 40-member global scientific panel on the impacts and risks of artificial intelligence, with the United States strongly objecting.
